_comment: HIGH/CRITICAL findings accepted on purpose (Plan 11.5). 'accepted' lists single finding ids; 'accepted_sources' accepts a whole scan source (here: third-party container images, whose OS packages and bundled Go binaries we do not build). scripts/supply-chain.ps1 fails on anything else. Every entry needs a reason; review them whenever the image tags change. Details: docs/reports/hardening-supply-chain.md.

accepted_sources.reason: postgis/postgis:16-3.5 is built on Debian 11 (end of life): 151 of 255 findings have no fix in any package source, and the tags 16-3.5-bookworm and 16-3.6 do not exist upstream (checked 2026-10-15). Local development database only (port bound to 127.0.0.1, dev placeholder credentials, SYNTHETIC data). A production database is not defined yet (ADR-71); it must be a managed or maintained Postgres 16 image. Moving the dev volume to another libc would also change text collation, so the tag is not changed here.

2 HIGH in libssl3/libcrypto3 (OpenSSL 3.3.7-r1, fixed in the -r2 Alpine package). Fix is an upstream image rebuild of redis:7-alpine; the tag floats, so a pull picks it up. Redis holds no authoritative data and is bound to 127.0.0.1.

10 HIGH inside the Prometheus Go binaries (Go standard library, golang.org/x/net). v3.15.0 is the newest tag published; fixed only by an upstream release. Observability profile only, bound to 127.0.0.1.

56 HIGH inside the Go binaries of Grafana and its bundled data-source plugins (stdlib 1.26.6/1.26.7, x/net, grpc). Moved from 13.2.3 to 13.2.4, the newest tag, which removed 8 of 64. The rest is fixed only by an upstream release. Observability profile only, bound to 127.0.0.1, anonymous viewer.

16 HIGH (Go standard library inside k6, OpenSSL in the Alpine base). Developer load-test tool, run with --rm against the local stack; moved from 1.3.0 (71 findings, 4 CRITICAL) to 1.8.2. Never deployed.
